description.value:
You touch a willing creature. Before the power ends, the target may roll a d4 once and add the result to one ability check of its choice, after which the power ends.

The bonus die improves at higher levels: a d6 at 5th level, a d8 at 11th level, and a d10 at 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
